# /discuss — Discuss a decision

## Outcome
Clarify the choices that materially affect the current work. Apply
`.memory-bank/workflows/execute-loop.md#working-policy`.

Use the request and relevant existing evidence. Ask a focused question or a small
related group, explain its consequences, and recommend an answer when useful.
Do not require an existing artifact, separate workflow, fixed questionnaire, or
approval form before having the conversation.

Keep accepted answers distinct from recommendations. Reuse previous decisions.
In authorized autonomous work, resolve choices within the delegated scope; ask
only when a decision exceeds it. Silence does not grant authority.

## Durable result
Apply an accepted decision to its natural canonical owner: product requirements,
feature, spec, task, or existing protocol. Create a necessary missing owner only
when it helps preserve the decision; do not create a second decision registry.
Remove superseded contradictory wording and note unresolved questions where the
next agent will find them. A separate decision log is optional.

A discussion request alone does not authorize unrelated implementation or external
side effects. Continue already authorized work once its question is resolved.

## Handoff
Summarize the decision, changed artifact when any, and the next useful action.
No owning-command round trip or separate review is required merely because a
question was discussed.
